name: interview-planning-chat
description: Structured interview guide with competencies, behavioral questions, and STAR probes. Emits interview-plan-report. Not a hire decision.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include JD, screening matrix, or interview format.

inputs.name: job-description
inputs.description: Job posting to derive competencies and questions.

inputs.name: interview-format
inputs.description: Phone, video, panel, or onsite context.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: interview-plan-report
outputs.description: Structured interviewer guide; empty when JD or matrix is missing.
